tagline.en: Flexible day-pass eSIMs with pay-as-you-go daily plans
tagline.zh: 灵活的日包eSIM，支持按天自定义的出行方案

description.en: RedteaGO is the consumer eSIM brand of Redtea Mobile, covering 180+ countries and regions. Its signature Unlimited Packages let you pick anywhere from 1 to 180 days, refreshing a daily high-speed allowance (300 MB basic / 10 GB premium) with unlimited throttled usage afterwards, alongside classic 1–50 GB data-only bundles valid up to 15 days.
description.zh: RedteaGO 是红茶移动（Redtea Mobile）旗下的消费者eSIM品牌，覆盖180+国家和地区。招牌不限量套餐可自选1–180天，每天刷新高速流量（基础版300 MB/日，尊享版10 GB/日），用尽后降速不限量；同时提供1–50 GB经典数据套餐，有效期最长15天。

details.en:
What makes RedteaGO different is how the Unlimited Package is priced: you pay a flat day rate instead of buying a fixed-duration bundle, so a 9-day trip or a 41-day working holiday costs exactly what it should — no rounding up to the next preset package. Day rates vary by destination: roughly $0.70/day (300 MB/day basic) or $3.90/day (10 GB/day premium) in Japan, $4.90/day for the 10 GB tier in the USA, and around $4.50/day in the UK. If you burn through the daily allowance, speeds drop but data keeps flowing — handy for maps, messaging and email. Classic data-only bundles (1–50 GB, 1–15 days) suit short trips with predictable usage, and multi-country regional packages undercut buying each country separately. US-destination bundles with calling and SMS are also available for travellers who still need a reachable number.

Beyond travel data, RedteaGO also sells a keep-alive global eSIM (~$3 first year, $3.3/year renewal) that bundles an Austrian phone number with 100 MB and unlimited SMS receiving for 365 days — verified receiving SMS while roaming in mainland China; it must be activated within 3 months of purchase, and the yearly clock starts at activation.
details.zh:
RedteaGO 的差异化在于不限量套餐的计价方式：按天计费而非固定时长打包，9 天行程或 41 天打工度假都只按实际天数付费，不必向上凑整到预设套餐。日费因目的地而异：日本约 0.70 美元/天（基础版 300 MB/日）或 3.90 美元/天（尊享版 10 GB/日），美国 10 GB 档为 4.90 美元/天，英国约 4.50 美元/天。当日高速额度用尽后降速但不断网，地图、即时通讯和邮件不受影响。经典数据套餐（1–50 GB、1–15 天有效）适合用量可预估的短途行程；覆盖多国的区域套餐（如含日本及周边的亚洲包、美加包）比逐国单买更划算；美国方向还提供带通话与短信的套餐，适合需要保持号码可接听的旅行者。

此外 RedteaGO 还提供保号向的全球 eSIM（首年约 3 美元，续期 3.3 美元/年）：自带奥地利号码+100MB流量+365天无限收短信，实测中国大陆漫游可正常收短信；

须在购买后 3 个月内激活，有效期自激活起算。

bestFor.en: Trips of unusual length (9, 12, 23 days...) where fixed 7/10/15-day bundles force overpaying, and travellers who want a daily throttled-unlimited safety net.
bestFor.zh: 行程天数不规整（如 9、12、23 天）、买固定 7/10/15 天包必然浪费的旅行者，以及每天都要有“降速不断网”兜底流量的用户。

en: Pay-per-day pricing fits any trip length without overpaying
Daily-refreshed high-speed allowance instead of one shared pool
Throttled unlimited fallback keeps maps and messaging alive
Calling + SMS bundles available for US destinations

降速不断网的兜底机制，地图和即时通讯始终可用
美国方向提供含通话短信的套餐
